description: This file is a PHPUnit test class that verifies the uniqueness of route keys across plugin configurations in the OrangeHRM system. It loads route definitions from YAML files for multiple plugins and asserts that route keys are not duplicated, throwing an exception if duplicates are found.

classes.name: UniqueRouteKeyTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for verifying uniqueness of route keys across plugin route definitions within OrangeHRM.

methods.name: testUniqueRouteKey
methods.description: Loads routes from plugin configuration files and checks for duplicate route keys, asserting success or throwing an exception if duplicates exist.
